dedupe_keys.name: seismic fragility of monopole telecommunication towers incremental dynamic analysis dataset

description: This dataset contains the structural and numerical data of a seismic fragility assessment of monopole telecommunication towers of different heights by Omer Bilginer and Himmet Karaman. It includes AutoCAD drawings of three monopole tower configurations, the fragility curves derived by incremental dynamic analysis and pushover analysis with their Excel data and graphs, and the figures of the associated publication. Fragility curves give the probability that a tower reaches a damage state for a given ground-motion intensity, which is the standard input for earthquake risk models of infrastructure. Coverage: three generic steel monopole designs of the kind used in Türkiye; published on 19 May 2026. Format and access: a RAR archive of about 3 MB with DWG drawings and XLSX tables on Zenodo; free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: results are for the modelled designs and ground motions; soil, antenna loads and connections differ between real sites; the archive format needs an unpacker. Simulation uses: fragility functions for earthquake hazard exposure and damage modelling of mobile network sites, feeding resilience and restoration studies of telecom networks after earthquakes. Related records: HAZUS gives generic communication facility fragility, and ANFR and OpenCelliD give tower locations.
